name: Solitude Pipeline System
monitor_reason: length: no sourced pipe length (partners have not published mileage, route, or cost); fails add-threshold leg (d)
researcher_notes: Not a match to existing rows. P7837 Eiger Express is a single 42 inch line of about 450 miles and P3882 Matterhorn Express is 42 inch, 580 miles, with different owners. Solitude is two new 48 inch lines from the Permian Basin to Katy, Texas. A BIC Magazine article from 17 August 2026 and a Pipeline and Gas Journal article from August 2026 both report a final investment decision. Owners are WhiteWater 50 percent, Devon 25, MPLX 10, Diamondback 7.5 and Western Midstream 7.5. Capacity is about 2.25 Bcf per day in late 2029 and another 2.25 Bcf per day in 2030. Sponsor and FID are confirmed, but no source found states length, route or cost. Likely well over 25 km, but the rule needs a sourced length. Promote to new_row once a length or Texas Railroad Commission T-4 filing appears. Both sources trace to one joint press release.
